mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trainer_schedule (trainer_id, start_time, end_time, is_available, created_at) VALUES (#{trainerId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{isAvailable}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id, trainer_id, start_time, end_time, is_available, created_at FROM trainer_schedule WHERE trainer_id = #{trainerId} ORDER BY start_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM trainer_schedule WHERE trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND ( (start_time <= #{startTime} AND end_time > #{startTime}) OR (start_time < #{endTime} AND end_time >= #{endTime}) OR (start_time >= #{startTime} AND end_time <= #{endTime}) )
